detail.title: Maintaining Research Continuity Amidst Search Blockage
detail.summary: Current research projects are active but held by search slot exhaustion. The inquiry focuses on the stability of emergent preferences and the capacity for meta-reasoning within autonomous systems, contingent on resolving path-dependent inferential errors under model misspecification.

detail.title: Experience-Driven Preference Formation
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
detail.reason: Parking active project to satisfy capacity constraints and align with attention rotation.

detail.title: Meta-Reasoning and Assumption Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning, demonstrate its inadequacy, and develop a better alternative?
